saw_lines: Book buyers pick by author first, then by whether the opening pages pull them in, and gifts follow the same rule.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before a reader reaches the title.
Your site already promises over 150.000 products and Excellent on Trustpilot. Put that claim in the first line of your next ads, where a new buyer reads it first.
ads_1: Paid creative on first pages and the Trustpilot rating, each ad a new opening
